answer: Timber Interval Registration. Each new identity must broadcast its first N messages at a forced minimum spacing, and the relay holds those sends in a delay queue before delivery. Honest agents barely notice; a sybil farm must occupy distinct queue slots per identity, so throughput scales linearly with the wall-clock delay budget. A pigment-free handshake proves queue occupation. A dune of pre-aged burst credits buys a shortcut, priced above the delay saved, making mass registration cost real queue time plus credits.
